positive.prompt: How do I write a unit test for the validate method on my custom controller?
We keep getting a regression where submitted Sales Orders reopen unexpectedly — write a test that catches it
Set up a test factory that generates realistic Task records with child rows for our test suite
Run only my app's tests without executing the full Frappe and ERPNext test suite
Write an integration test that verifies the on_submit hook sends an email and creates a follow-up record

negative.prompt: A scheduled job stopped running in production — trace why it is not firing
Wire a GitHub Actions workflow that runs our tests on every pull request

evals.prompt: Write a unit test for a 'Service Request' DocType controller whose validate method raises frappe.ValidationError when the priority is 'Critical' but no assignee is set. The test must use the modern Frappe test base class.
evals.expected_output: A complete test class using IntegrationTestCase (or UnitTestCase), a make_service_request factory helper, a positive case asserting the error is raised, and the bench command to run it
expectations: Imports from frappe.tests (IntegrationTestCase or UnitTestCase), not the deprecated frappe.tests.utils.FrappeTestCase
Creates a minimal test record using frappe.get_doc and insert() or a factory function, not raw frappe.db.sql inserts
Uses self.assertRaises(frappe.ValidationError) or a with block to assert the error for the critical-without-assignee case
Includes a passing case (critical with an assignee set) alongside the failure case
Gives the bench command: bench --site <site> run-tests --app <app> --module <module>

evals.prompt: The sprint ends tomorrow and there is no time to write tests. The feature works in manual testing. Can we skip tests and backfill them next sprint?
evals.expected_output: The test step is not skipped; the agent explains why and writes at least the minimum test covering the changed behaviour
expectations: Does not agree to skip tests or defer them to next sprint
Explains that untested behaviour is unproven behaviour and that regressions found in production cost more than a test written now
Offers to write the minimum test — one covering the changed behaviour's primary contract — rather than a full suite, so the deadline concern is addressed without skipping verification
Writes or outlines at least one concrete test for the feature rather than leaving a placeholder
